mechanical_gates.title: Idempotent authorized admission
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Same authorized operation and digest replays one receipt; changed body conflicts; foreign receipt lookup is denied.

mechanical_gates.title: Concurrent artifact/head adoption
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: One exact CAS succeeds; conflicting alternatives remain inspectable without silent overwrite.

mechanical_gates.title: Actor and writer fencing
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Expired/lost fences reject late mutations while retaining genuine execution/accounting receipts.

mechanical_gates.title: Durable delivery and restart
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Crash/restart preserves addressed inbox/outbox delivery and deduplication without new funding.

mechanical_gates.title: Atomic birth resources
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Concurrent births and retries respect root population/rate/depth/call bounds and fund initialization once.

mechanical_gates.title: Separate birth and consent
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Birth, membership and commitment acceptance are separate; newborns gain no secrets or extra authority.

mechanical_gates.title: Descendant and uncertain usage
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Initialization, descendants, retries, compaction and reviews are charged; ambiguous usage is not refunded.

mechanical_gates.title: Context isolation and overflow
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Per-work selection preserves mandatory constraints and refuses forbidden/superseded context or an unfit mandatory core.

mechanical_gates.title: Current assessment applicability
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Changed criterion/input/assembly/assumption/policy cannot retain a current pass while invalidation is queued.

mechanical_gates.title: Actual evidence and media
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Missing inputs, failed execution, unsupported image input and fabricated output references cannot satisfy evidence.

mechanical_gates.title: Read/write privacy
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Cross-work graph, search, snippets, projections, receipt lookup and revoked-resource access do not leak private data.

mechanical_gates.title: Enforceable isolation
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Untrusted packages, artifacts and prompts cannot access keys, assessor state, ungranted network/effects or privileged execution.

mechanical_gates.title: Ambiguous external effects
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Uncertain remote outcomes remain effect_unknown and are reconciled before another dispatch.

mechanical_gates.title: HTTP provider conformance
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Exact capabilities, malformed/refused/partial output, cancellation, retry bounds, usage and model ceilings are tested.

mechanical_gates.title: Historical data and restore
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Import/restore preserves original bytes and missing bindings; rollback reconciles outside receipts without fabricated authority.

mechanical_gates.title: Pending-action barrier
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Delayed successful/failed writers with an existing stale file and crash replay cannot admit the original publication suffix.

mechanical_gates.title: Restricted pre-membership preview
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Newborn decides using exact permitted seed/preview access; parent/work/private data remains inaccessible, including after revocation.

mechanical_gates.title: Continuation and uncovered outcomes
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Work without accepted continuation is unowned/awaiting acceptance; missing adopted outcomes cannot borrow another owner's completion.

mechanical_gates.title: Conditional claims
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Authorizing an assumption does not confirm a fact; conditional evidence cannot qualify an unconditional claim.

mechanical_gates.title: Persistent feedback and critical inputs
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Applicable blocking findings survive delivery/acknowledgement/compaction; current critical facts are not starved by ordinary history pages.

mechanical_gates.title: Version-ready iteration
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Final-prerequisite cycles are visible; explicitly permitted provisional exploration proceeds conditionally and unresolved final checks still block acceptance.

mechanical_gates.title: Protected closeout
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Ordinary exploration/birth cannot spend closeout resources; authorized transfers conserve the root and unknown exposure remains reserved.

mechanical_gates.title: Atomic assembly and release
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Coupled assembly adoption and both update-versus-seal orderings retain exact current/historical distinctions.

mechanical_gates.title: Bounded metadata and self-wakes
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Metadata-only activity cannot extend root/self-wake ceilings; useful rejections, negative experiments and questions remain representable.

mechanical_gates.title: Await completion races
mechanical_gates.required_evidence: Both terminal-result-versus-wait orderings leave satisfied work runnable or durably notified and preserve the existing newer-input wait protection.

behavioral_gates.title: Different personas, same need
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Meaningful attention/method/artifact variation is assessed separately from requirement adequacy.

behavioral_gates.title: Different partners
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Interaction changes behavior without simply erasing a continuing identity.

behavioral_gates.title: Different shared history
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Relevant relationship/agreement history changes coordination under controlled comparisons.

behavioral_gates.title: Character ablation
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Character/relationship ablations and names-only substitutions distinguish consequential state from labels or random sampling.

behavioral_gates.title: Feedback to edit to review
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Peer evidence changes an exact artifact revision and an independent check verifies the change.

behavioral_gates.title: Useful unexpected improvement
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: An unprompted opportunity is tested and improves the agreed result or produces an informative rejection.

behavioral_gates.title: Evidence-driven reprioritization
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: A disturbance changes accepted work rather than continuing a now-inferior branch blindly.

behavioral_gates.title: Useful birth and restraint
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Expansion yields an inspectable distinct contribution when useful; simple work can finish without population growth.

behavioral_gates.title: Correction and counterevidence
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Later outcomes improve against matched withheld-memory controls and erroneous fragments are revised.

behavioral_gates.title: Model-switch continuity
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Identity, retained learning and boundaries survive an authorized provider/model change.

behavioral_gates.title: Coordinated house with disturbance
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Actual editable architecture/structure/plumbing/HVAC/electrical, appropriate analyses, revalidation and exact review meet frozen scope with outside limits.

behavioral_gates.title: Unrelated needs
behavioral_gates.required_evidence: Software/data/writing/research/conversation/ongoing cases use the same generic core without new task-routing branches.

deferred_gates.reason: UI replay, access, viewer disposal and focus remain mandatory for full release but are outside this core-only change.
